subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “For Mother's Day, Eric tried to bake a cake.”?
options: "That was the first movie your mother and I watched together," he said.
Her mother said the restored photo helped them see the people better.
One Saturday, their mother said she would not remind anyone anymore.
Eric felt disappointed, but his mother said the effort mattered more than the cake.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「'That was the first movie your mother and I watched together,' he said.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Her mother said the restored photo helped them see the people better.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One Saturday, their mother said she would not remind anyone anymore.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Eric felt disappointed, but his mother said the effort mattered more than the cake.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Eric felt disappointed, but his mother said the effort mattered more than the cake.」，答案為「Eric felt disappointed, but his mother said the effort mattered more than the cake.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Eric felt disappointed, but his mother said the effort mattered more than the cake.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
